prompt: The crowd of ordinary people in casual clothes keeps walking forward away from the camera from the very first second, splitting into two lines and disappearing into the glowing golden palace gate on the left and the glowing cyan tower doorway on the right. A bright flash of light pulses from both doors. Then new people stream OUT of the doors toward the camera: from the golden palace gate, Joseon dynasty people in hanbok and black gat hats walking gracefully, from the cyan tower doorway, people in shiny silver futuristic suits with glowing visors marching in step while small drones fly beside them. Camera locked, static high aerial view, the two gates and the sky stay exactly the same, continuous motion of people the whole time.
